verdict: PASS for the exact frozen code and planned source-only one-shot entry. This is a pre-forward review, not model quality certification.

entry_precedence.order: Explicit root approval and exact code/protocol/generated/runtime/source-seal/review/receipt/allowlist checks precede model loading and source pixels. Runtime RAM/disk/GPU guards precede model loading. Output must be new and failure is preserved.
entry_precedence.nested_binding_scope: The root-approved entry must bind this REVIEW and the exact code/generated SHAs. The runner checks those files and PASS; nested review-code staleness is covered by this exact binding and root entry review, not an additional automatic recursive guard.

resource_and_runtime.one_tmpfs_copy_scope: The literal tmpfs model path and non-symlink primary weight are enforced; one-copy intake is supplied by the separate root asset receipt, not a whole-filesystem duplicate scan.

inputs_calls_and_semantic_scope.context: Canonical full RGB copy plus saved predicted box and query markers only.
inputs_calls_and_semantic_scope.query_view: Original unmarked RGB96 remains intact; a separate bicubic 256 view is passed to the official processor. No detail is created by upsampling.
inputs_calls_and_semantic_scope.native_order_query_L: Saved original order and q/L retained; no GT recenter, native identity, semantic D/E/S, or annotation text supplied.

parser_failure.schema: Exact four output keys; fixed enums and nonempty note <=400 characters.
parser_failure.malformed: Raw generation retained as UNPARSED_UNCERTAIN with no repair or retry; remaining fixed calls continue.
parser_failure.runtime_exception: Halt and preserve partial output/log, no automatic retry.

chronology.interpretation: The filename BEFORE_MODEL_WEIGHTS means before model parameter deserialization/forward. A separately authorized root asset-only download and byte-SHA verification ran in parallel before final forward protocol review. It is not a claim that the protocol preceded weight-byte download.

limitations: No reviewer pretrained weight-body read, model construction, actual forward, source pixel read, current read, or quality evaluation occurred. Prior official processor readiness is a bound generated-image receipt, not a model-forward test.

Visible-content outputs and free text remain fallible weak observations. The parser validates syntax/enums, not visual truth or unsupported claims inside the note. Standard JSON parsing uses last-value-wins for duplicate keys; no semantic label is admitted from the result.
Native8 expected-part identity and intended-target ownership remain unproved. A visible foreign object is not evidence that an unspecified native part is externally covered.

Full-frame context and visible query markers supplement the 96 crop; this pilot is not a crop-only semantic-visibility benchmark. The same 20 public development frames were already visually reviewed, so no fresh generalization or human-gold claim is available.

Runtime import/processor readiness and free-memory checks do not guarantee successful model loading or complete execution. Model parameters are not independently hash-compared in memory; the planned seal checks unchanged weight-file bytes and zero optimizer updates.
PASS authorizes no execution by itself, no training-label admission, no current223 access, and no goal-completion claim. Root must bind this exact review in its separate approved forward entry.
